question: The paper removed these two 25 h cold samples of the replicated experiment (B73 and W22, replicate 2) for poor correlation with their biological replicates and substituted time-course samples TC64 and TC66. Both runs are in the repository. Keep them?
proposed_answer: Set include = FALSE for both (done in the sheet). B73 and W22 25 h cold then keep two replicates each (HY97+HY103; HY99+HY105). TC64 and TC66 stay as unreplicated time-course samples; do not add them as third replicates unless you decide to follow the authors.
evidence: Methods, RNA-seq data processing: "Two samples from the replicated experiment at the 25 h time point (HY91 and HY93) were also removed due to poor correlation with other biological replicates and substituted by two from the time-course samples (TC64 and TC66)".

question: The diversity panel should have 100 samples (25 inbreds x control/cold x 1/25 h) but KI11 has no NM_Cold_1h sample here (99 runs). Is that the sample dropped in library prep?
proposed_answer: Yes: the paper reports one sample omitted for too little cDNA. KI11 therefore has control 1 h, control 25 h and cold 25 h only, so no KI11 1 h cold contrast is possible.
evidence: Methods: "One sample did not meet the minimum cDNA content requirement during RNA-seq library preparation and was omitted"; 291 runs in PRJNA747925 vs 292 samples in the paper; NM11 absent from the run list.

question: What does the NM prefix mean? The paper does not define HY, TC or NM.
proposed_answer: HY = replicated hybrid experiment (Fig. 1 legend: "B73 samples from the hybrid experiment"), TC = time-course experiment, NM = diversity panel (25 inbreds x 4 = 100 samples matches the third experiment). Panel lines are used as named in the BioSample (KI3, KI11, Il14H, Mo18W, OH43, OH7B, ...). The paper makes no tolerance claims, so cold_tolerance = NR for all.
evidence: Methods: three experiments (replicated 126 samples, time course 66, panel 100); sample counts per prefix in runs.tsv match (HY 126, TC 66, NM 99).

question: B73, Mo17 and W22 occur in all three experiments (HY, TC, NM) at overlapping hours (e.g. B73 cold 1 h: 3 HY replicates, 1 TC, 1 NM), and replicate numbers repeat across experiments. How should groups be formed?
proposed_answer: other_factor = experiment with levels HY replicated inbred/F1 experiment, TC time-course experiment, NM 25-inbred diversity panel, so each cold sample pairs with controls of its own experiment (same genotype, same hour). Contrasts should be built within experiment; HY gives the replicated contrasts, TC and NM contrasts are unreplicated single-pair comparisons (decide at the contrast stage whether TC/NM B73, Mo17 and W22 pairs are pooled with HY).
evidence: Methods: three experiments run late May to early July 2019 with separate sample sets; alias prefixes HY, TC, NM in the BioSample treatment attribute.

item: Control for cold contrasts (time-matched vs time 0)
question: Each cold sample at 0.5-25 h has two possible comparators: the time-matched control and the 0 h control (HY and TC designs). Which should contrasts use?
proposed_answer: Use the time-matched control (same genotype, same hour) as the primary comparator, as the spec says, and keep the 0 h control as an optional secondary contrast. Both are in the sheet (phase control, time_h 0 or matched hour). The paper calls DEGs relative to both and keeps the intersection.
evidence: Results and Fig. 1D legend: DEGs "relative to the control sample collected at time 0 ... and relative to the control sample collected at the matching time point".

question: The paper says W22 lacks the 3 h and 8 h time points; the run list also lacks 1.5 h. Is a W22 1.5 h library missing?
proposed_answer: W22 has 11 cold/control libraries (control 0, 0.5, 1, 2, 4, 25 h; cold 0.5, 1, 2, 4, 25 h) and none at 1.5, 3 and 8 h. The paper count of 66 time-course samples equals 3 genotypes x 25 libraries minus 9 (three W22 time points x control, cold, heat), so three W22 time points were never sequenced and the text (two points) undercounts. Authors imputed the missing points computationally; no imputed data are in the repository.
evidence: Methods: "due to low germination, several time points were omitted for W22"; "The two missing time points in W22 (3 and 8 h) were imputed from the two neighboring time points". TC runs per genotype: B73 8 cold + 9 control, Mo17 8 + 9, W22 5 + 6.

question: Methods name the hybrids B73xMo17, B73xW22 and Mo17xW22, but the Results introduction and the BioSample cultivar attribute give W22xB73 and W22xMo17. Reciprocal crosses or just naming?
proposed_answer: Keep the BioSample names (W22xB73, W22xMo17, B73xMo17); the paper uses the same names in the Results introduction. The female parent was not verified, so treat the order as a label only.
evidence: Results introduction: "B73xMo17, W22xB73, and W22xMo17"; Methods: "B73xMo17, B73xW22, and Mo17xW22"; BioSample cultivar attribute W22xB73, W22xMo17.

item: Plants per sample and plant age
question: Pool size is given as 3-4 seedlings (replicated and time-course experiments) and 3 seedlings (panel); the Methods closing sentence says 3 seedlings for each replicate. Plant age is "Day 9" without saying from when.
proposed_answer: pooled_plants left empty for HY and TC (3-4 per sample), 3 for NM. age_days = 9 for samples taken on Day 9 and 10 for the 25 h samples (treatment started on Day 9, 2 h after dawn); the day count is assumed to start at seed hydration (catalogue wording), not verified.
evidence: Methods: "each sample was a pool of tissue from 3 to 4 individual seedlings"; "hydrated for 24 h ... grown ... to the V2/V3 stage (Day 9)"; "V2 leaves from three maize seedlings were collected and pooled".

question: Cold is 6/2 °C day/night but temperature readings (Fig. 1B) are sensor traces, and the cold may take minutes to reach 6 °C. The 25 h cold samples passed through one night at 2 °C. Is time_h measured from the chamber switch?
proposed_answer: time_h is hours since stress onset (2 h after dawn on Day 9). temperature_C = 6 and temperature_night_C = 2 for all cold samples; controls 30/20. All sampling points fall in the light phase (2 h after dawn + 0 to 25 h).
evidence: Methods: "stress treatment (cold or heat) was initiated 2 h after dawn on Day 9 (i.e. time zero) ... The temperature settings for control, cold, and heat conditions were 30 °C/20 °C, 6 °C/2 °C, and 39 °C/29 °C".

question: The 0 h, 1 h and 25 h controls also serve as comparators for the heat treatment (heat runs excluded in runs.tsv). Any issue?
proposed_answer: No: controls are curated as plain control samples of this study; heat samples are not in the sheet.
evidence: runs.tsv exclude_reason "heat treatment, no cold contrast" for 57 runs.
